summary: Refactor-only regression pass (iteration 4). Ran full pytest suite twice (once bare, once with TEST_* env vars) — 60/60 pass in ~13s both times. Verified every regression focus called out in the review request: (1) 3 successive COD orders returned 3 distinct order numbers all matching ^IFQ\d{10}$ (IFQ2608132247/IFQ2608132976/IFQ2608138601 via curl, IFQ2608138505 via UI checkout). (2) Seeded a user_sessions row per /app/auth_testing.md: prefix confirmed to be 'emg_'; /api/auth/me + /api/orders authenticate via Bearer AND cookie; cookie-based POST /api/auth/logout deletes the row (subsequent /me → 401). (3) POST /api/auth/session with X-Session-ID:bogus → 401 'Invalid or expired session'. JWT admin+customer login/register/me/logout all still work. (4) React memoisation: header cart badge goes 0→1→2 live when adding two different variants of the SAME product (Color+Material combos), same badge collapses to hidden after emptying cart. Login on /login makes account-link+logout-btn appear in the header WITHOUT a manual refresh; logout instantly restores the LOGIN CTA. (5) Cart re-quote runs on add/remove/qty change (totals updated ₹6598 → ₹8907 after qty+); WELCOME10 remains applied after a qty change (discount 660 → 990 as expected). (6) Stable list keys work — PDP thumb-1 click actually swaps the main image src; cart renders 2 SEPARATE rows for the same product with different variants; localStorage cart survives full page reload (2 rows still there). (7) Full COD checkout end-to-end via UI reached the order page with a valid IFQ order_no. (8) Razorpay disabled path: /api/payments/config → configured:false, /api/payments/razorpay/order with a proper cart body → 503, POST /api/orders with payment_method online → 400 'Use the Razorpay flow', pay-online button on /checkout has disabled=true. (9) Admin path: customer hitting /api/admin/stats → 403, admin → 200 with stats payload. (10) Mobile 390px: home/category/PDP (sticky add-to-cart-btn-mobile present)/cart/checkout all have scrollWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow) and no non-auth console errors.

minor.issue: Only deletes the user_sessions row if the client sent the session_token via COOKIE. Calling logout with only an Authorization: Bearer <session_token> header returns 200 but does NOT delete the row and the token remains valid on /api/auth/me. Cookie-based logout works correctly. Consider reading Bearer as fallback in the logout handler, matching get_current_user.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Extend logout() to also delete the session row when the token arrives as a Bearer header, not only as a cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart data-testid on the row wrapper is `cart-item-${product_id}` — for two variants of the SAME product this yields duplicate testids on the page (two rows with the same data-testid). The React key correctly includes variant, but the testid does not. Suggest `cart-item-${product_id}-${variantHash}` or similar so tests can target each row uniquely.
server.py still ~785 lines — carry-over from iterations 1-3, no action needed for this refactor pass.
Iteration 3's minor notes (razorpay_cancel timeline entry, refund audit trail, awaiting_payment stock race) are still open but out of scope for this crypto-safe-random / memoisation refactor.

success_rate.backend: 100% (60/60 pytest, ran both with and without TEST_* env vars)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the regression scope (memoisation, list keys, cart, checkout, mobile)

seed_data_creation: 4 real COD orders were placed against customer@infykraq.com (IFQ2608132247, IFQ2608132976, IFQ2608138601, IFQ2608138505) plus 1 additional COD order via the mobile UI test — all left in the customer's order history for reference. One order (IFQ2608132976) was moved to 'shipped' via admin. One transient user_sessions row (emg_test<ts>) was inserted and then deleted after logout verification (deletedCount=1 confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 60 pytest cases pass in isolation and together (flaky admin-stats test from iteration_3 did not resurface this run). Frontend regression targets from the refactor (useMemo on Auth+Cart contexts, itemsKey in Cart useEffect, stable react keys on PDP thumbs / cart rows / checkout summary) all behave correctly: header updates live on login/logout, cart badge updates live on add/remove, two-variant-same-product produces two independent cart rows, coupon persists across qty changes, PDP thumb click switches main image. No new bugs. Only nit: cookie-required logout for Google sessions (minor) and duplicate cart-item-<pid> testids for multi-variant same product (test-ergonomics nit).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs introduced by the refactor. The two nits noted above pre-date this iteration.
